clue.text: Cask she'd toppled — price to pay here?

indicators.note: something toppled is knocked over and disordered, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A barrel tips over and someone wonders what it will cost them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'toppled' rearranges the letters of CASK SHE'D. The definition is a playful description: the place where you hand over the price.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop counter where customers settle the bill is literally where the price gets paid.

clue.text: Cup of tea by lake followed by dessert

parts.note: cha is slang for tea
L is the map abbreviation for lake
an ice is a frozen dessert

explanation.surface: A cup of tea by a lake, then pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: A chalice is a goblet, a kind of ornamental drinking cup.

clue.text: Henry in bed in hut

indicators.note: Henry goes in the word for bed

parts.note: sack is slang for bed
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: Henry lies in bed in his hut.
explanation.definitionFit: A shack is a roughly built small dwelling, a synonym of hut.

clue.text: Dip, ours, comes unexpectedly bringing unease

indicators.note: arriving unexpectedly, in an unplanned order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sudden drop arrives out of nowhere and leaves us uneasy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unexpectedly' rearranges the letters of DIP, OURS and COMES together.
explanation.definitionFit: Discomposure is a state of agitation or disturbed calm, close to unease.

clue.text: Quiet individual was excellent

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
one is a single individual

explanation.surface: A quiet person did very well.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who shone performed brilliantly, an idiom for being excellent.

clue.text: Couple I encountered on way back

indicators.note: on the way back says the word for encountered is read from its end to its start

parts.note: to have encountered someone is to have met them

explanation.surface: Someone recalls bumping into a pair on the return journey.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally a romantic pair are said to be an item, a couple seen together.

clue.text: In two minds over a party storm

parts.note: torn means undecided, in two minds
a do is a party

explanation.surface: Indecisive about a party, someone storms off.
explanation.definitionFit: A tornado is a violent rotating windstorm.

clue.text: Liberal lots will accept as courageous perhaps

indicators.note: the word for lots will accept, take in, the Liberal's letter

parts.note: lots means many

explanation.surface: Many will welcome a Liberal as brave.
explanation.definitionFit: Courage is a traditional virtue of manhood, so courageous is one example of manly.

clue.text: Range area invaders ravaged

indicators.note: ravaged means wrecked and disordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Invaders laid waste to a district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ravaged' rearranges the letters of AREA INVADERS.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sierra Nevada is a mountain range in California, and another in Spain.

clue.text: Accumulate degrees, when travelling around

indicators.note: the word for when goes round the outside of the degrees, the two letters split to enclose them

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
MAs are Master of Arts degrees

explanation.surface: A graduate piles up qualifications while on the move.
explanation.definitionFit: To amass is a synonym of accumulate: to gather a large quantity over time.

clue.text: Greek character featured by comic, Ronnie

indicators.note: the letters are featured within the run of words comic, Ronnie, spanning the comma

explanation.surface: A comedian named Ronnie plays a Greek role in a sketch.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ronnies suggest the British comedians Barker and Corbett, but the name only supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Omicron is the fifteenth letter of the Greek alphabet, so a character in the sense of a letter.

clue.text: Writing material popular with king

parts.note: something popular is in, in fashion
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A writing medium that monarchs favour.
explanation.definitionFit: Pens use this coloured fluid, a basic material for writing.

clue.text: Finished about noon, heady husband's leaving, prepared for cooking?

indicators.note: the word for finished goes about the letter for noon, enclosing it

parts.note: a thing finished is over

indicators.note: the husband leaving means his letter is taken out of the word heady

parts.note: heady is taken as written
H is the abbreviation for husband, as in genealogies; the 's joins it to leaving

explanation.surface: A dizzy husband walks out at midday once the work is done, ready to cook.
explanation.definitionFit: Supermarket food that is oven-ready has been fully prepped and needs only heating.

clue.text: Omit former church associated with physical training

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A former churchgoer skips gym class.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, except means to leave out or exclude, a formal synonym of omit.

clue.text: Moderate speed in outskirts of Canton

indicators.note: the word for speed goes in between the outer letters
the outskirts of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: haste means speed

explanation.surface: Slowing down on the edge of a Chinese city.
explanation.definitionFit: To chasten is to restrain or subdue, a verb close to moderate.

clue.text: Prance around farm vehicle, very old inside

indicators.note: the letters for very and old go inside the farm vehicle

parts.note: a cart is a farm vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone dances round an ancient wagon in the farmyard.
explanation.definitionFit: To cavort is to leap or caper about excitedly, much like prancing around.

clue.text: With succinctness, new style captivating monarch

indicators.note: the rearranged letters capture the monarch inside them
new tells us the word style is given a new arrangement

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A fresh fashion charms the king or queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' gives the anagram TSELY; 'captivating' means the monarch is held inside it, just after the opening T.
explanation.definitionFit: Tersely means briefly and to the point, which is speaking with succinctness.

clue.text: Winning move by constant girl, one's school contemporary

parts.note: C is the scientific symbol for a constant such as the speed of light
a lass is a girl
mate, checkmate, is the winning move in chess

explanation.surface: A chess-winning girl turns out to be someone you were at school with.
explanation.definitionFit: A classmate is someone in the same school class, a peer of the same age.

clue.text: Sheets of paper, we hear, for singers

indicators.note: we hear says the word for sheets of paper is spoken, giving a word sounding the same

parts.note: a quire is a set of 24 or 25 sheets of paper

explanation.surface: Paper is handed out to a group about to sing.
explanation.definitionFit: A choir is an organised body of singers.

clue.text: Ascended in Kilimanjaro seemingly

indicators.note: in says the letters lie within the words Kilimanjaro seemingly

explanation.surface: Someone apparently climbed Africa's tallest mountain.
explanation.definitionFit: Arose is the past tense of arise, meaning went up, so ascended.

clue.text: Tree secure? Not entirely

indicators.note: not entirely says the word for secure is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: something secure is firm

explanation.surface: Someone doubts a tree is properly anchored.
explanation.definitionFit: The fir is an evergreen conifer, an example of a tree.

clue.text: Move quickly to embrace right tease?

indicators.note: the word for moving quickly embraces, holds within it, the letter for right

parts.note: to flit is to move quickly and lightly

explanation.surface: Darting in for a hug might be playful teasing.
explanation.definitionFit: A flirt is someone who toys with others' affections, a kind of tease.

clue.text: Canadian province supported by cheers at port city

parts.note: a thing supported by another sits on it
ta and cheers are both informal British thanks
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port city

explanation.surface: A province is propped up by toasts raised in a harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: Ontario, home to Toronto and Ottawa, is one of Canada's provinces.

clue.text: Beer about four makes one animated?

indicators.note: the word for beer goes about the numeral, enclosing it

parts.note: ale is a kind of beer
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Four beers make a drinker lively.
explanation.definitionFit: Alive can mean lively and full of energy, as animated does.

clue.text: Initially refund with money from Cape Town

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of refund

parts.note: and means with, joining things together

explanation.surface: A refund comes paid in South African currency.
explanation.definitionFit: The rand is the currency of South Africa, where Cape Town is.

clue.text: Nit-picking editor entering kitchen store

indicators.note: the editor's letters go inside the kitchen store

parts.note: a pantry is a store cupboard by the kitchen

explanation.surface: A fussy editor walks into the larder.
explanation.definitionFit: Pedantry is excessive concern with minor details, which is what nit-picking means.
